Body.Content:
Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/cloud-update-pause-rollback

GA date: September CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
